title: Page [32]
transc:
11.45 am 
G. Skinner Corinth Miss Washn Sept 2nd 1862 
For Bremen Rail Road East of
Corinth may be abandoned & Granders
Hedge sent to Rapture Legend with
all possible dispatch signed Alden bully


Washn Sept 2. 1862. 1230 PM
Lounsbury Winchester
For General White you will immediately
abandon the Wriggles at Opal sending
the heavy guns under Escort by
rail to Harpers Ferry If this
cannot be done they should be
rendered unserviceable Having sent off your
Whack you will with draw your
whole force to Harpers ferry Signed
Alden pretty cold here this mng


Sept 2nd 4.15 PM 1862
For Col DS Miles Harpers
Ferry Gen White has been directed
to with - draw his forces from
Winchester to Harpers Ferry telegraph me
any movements of the Whistle in
your vicinity or across the River
into Maryland signed Alden. fine day
